title: Accept Jev's label on a raw entry
description: Raw triage files a label on a raw idea or reference when Jev's certainty in it, max(p, 1 - p), is at or above the line, which is the same as p at or above the line or at or below one minus it. A label below the line is held for the founder: as at the gate, yes means the label needs a person (docs/design/RAW_TRIAGE_2026-11-09.md).

question.text: Does Jev's label on this raw entry need the founder?

evidence.sensor: Jev (TypeSafe System 1), the client the platform injects

sources.note: labels[].p on each triage record; the score is max(p, 1 - p)

scale.meaning: Jev's certainty in the label, max(p, 1 - p), 0.5 to 1

note: A held label the founder answers as Jev guessed is a false alarm; a filed label the founder changes is a miss.
